sql: SELECT * FROM sales LIMIT 10;
SELECT Product, Quantity, TotalSale_FCFA FROM sales;
SELECT * FROM sales WHERE Branch = 'Nkwen';
SELECT * FROM sales WHERE Quantity > 10 ORDER BY Quantity DESC;

SELECT SalesRep, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM sales
GROUP BY SalesRep
HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;
SELECT DISTINCT PaymentMethod FROM sales;
SELECT * FROM sales WHERE Date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31';
SELECT * FROM sales WHERE Product LIKE '%Rice%';
SELECT * FROM sales WHERE Branch IN ('Nkwen', 'Mile 4');

SELECT b.Manager, SUM(s.TotalSale_FCFA) AS total
FROM sales s
JOIN branches b ON s.Branch = b.Branch
GROUP BY b.Manager;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE PaymentMethod = 'Mobile Money';
SELECT MAX(TotalSale_FCFA), MIN(TotalSale_FCFA) FROM sales;
SELECT Branch, City FROM branches WHERE OpenedYear < 2015;
SELECT * FROM branches ORDER BY OpenedYear;

SELECT Category, SUM(Quantity) AS units
FROM sales
GROUP BY Category
ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT * FROM sales WHERE SalesRep IS NULL;
SELECT Branch, COUNT(DISTINCT Product) AS products FROM sales GROUP BY Branch;

SELECT b.City, COUNT(s.Product) AS n
FROM branches b
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.Branch = b.Branch
GROUP BY b.City;
UPDATE sales SET TotalSale_FCFA = Quantity * UnitPrice_FCFA;
